name: Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS
access: Gemini API (Interactions API and generateContent; REST and SDKs)

Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (the model card lists it and the launch post said coming soon; Google Cloud's Text-to-Speech page says the 3.8 models are in Preview through the Gemini Enterprise API only, and not through the Cloud Text-to-Speech API)

voice.input_audio: none: the model takes text only, with the same speech_metadata annotations and inline tags as 3.8 Flash TTS. Reference audio goes only to the Voices API [g-tts-guide] [g-voice-repl]
voice.output_audio: The same as 3.8 Flash TTS: WAV (24 kHz, 16-bit, mono) by default on a unary request, raw L16 PCM at 24 kHz on a streaming request, and mu-law or A-law on request [g-tts-guide]. Output carries a SynthID watermark [g-blog-38]
voice.voices: custom cloning and voice design: the same 30 prebuilt studio voices, Extended Voice Library, voice design and voice replication as 3.8 Flash TTS, with 200 stored custom voices per project [g-tts-guide] [g-voice-design] [g-voice-repl]
languages: 101 languages by the model page table (the guide says over 100), with automatic detection of the input language [g-model-lite-page] [g-tts-guide]
voice.turn_detection: none: a synthesis model. Every turn of a multi-speaker request names its speaker in speech_metadata [g-tts-guide]
voice.interruption: Not a conversation model. The pages read describe no barge-in or cancel message; the client stops playback (inferred) [g-tts-guide]
voice.latency: Google publishes no time-to-first-audio figure and describes the model only as low latency. Artificial Analysis reports a median of 57.7 characters generated per second (throughput, not latency) [aa-g38l] [g-model-lite-page]
voice.session_limit: Input up to 8,192 tokens and output up to 16,384 tokens per request on the Gemini API; the model card gives 8K text in and 64K tokens of audio out [g-model-lite-page] [g-card-38]. A single request takes at most 2 speakers with prebuilt voices [g-tts-guide]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per token, Gemini API Standard tier, paid plan [g-pricing]. The input field is the text rate and the output field is the audio rate. Both rates are promotional until 2026-12-31 and double on 2027-01-01: text in US$0.50 then US$1.00, audio out US$6.00 then US$12.00 per Mtok. Audio counts 25 tokens a second, so the audio rate is about US$0.0015 per 10 seconds of speech until the change. Cached input is US$0.125 then US$0.25. Batch and Flex cost half of Standard. The free tier costs nothing and Google can use its data to improve products; the paid tier is not used for that. Artificial Analysis converts the price to US$11.0 per 1M characters [aa-pv].
